text.p: Georgia-Pacific Corp on Wednesday confirmed a newspaper report that said the company was expected to lay off hundreds of workers from its building products distribution division.
"It's a full cost-reduction effort that will include non-personnel expenses as well as personnel expenses," said spokeswoman Sheila Weidman.
Weidman said Georgia-Pacific has set no specific goal in terms of the number of layoffs.
"We don't have a target number. The division has 5,800 and what they've said is that there is not an explicit target number. (The report of) "hundreds of employees" was correct," she said.
She said the cost-reduction will probably last a few months. "This is an aggressive, concerted effort to reduce costs and grow sales," Weidman said.
The Atlanta Journal-Constitution said in an article that intended savings would amount to tens of millions of dollars.
